From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Great meeting at EdgeML Connect — quick intro and call?

Hi Clara,

Great to meet you at EdgeML Connect yesterday — I enjoyed hearing about Novaforge's edge inference roadmap and the challenges you're seeing around consistent latency across mixed-device fleets. Dylan and I chatted about a few ideas that could help, especially around prefix caching and small-quantization variants for CPU fallbacks.

Would you be open to a 30-minute discovery call next week to run through a quick workload profile and map out a potential pilot? I can do Tues (1/19) or Wed (1/20) mornings PT.

Quick context: Redwood Inference is focused on predictable production inference (latency SLOs, quantization options, unified runtime across hosted + private). If helpful I can send a short demo deck and our security questionnaire ahead of the call.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0187

Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (pilot outline & security questionnaire)

Hi Clara / Samir,

Thanks for the time this morning — good discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps below. Deck and questionnaire attached.

Summary (10:00am PT call)
- Problem: Novaforge needs <200ms p95 across mixed ARM/x86 gateways under budget.
- Key constraints: limited RAM on gateways, need for OpenTelemetry metrics, HIPAA-adjacent data handling in some regions.
- Redwood fit: fast KV prefix caching, dynamic routing to quantized CPU fallbacks, and per-route SLO enforcement.

Action items
1) Evelyn: share demo deck + security questionnaire (attached) — due EOD 1/21 if possible. (attachment: edgeml-demo-deck.pdf)
2) Novaforge: provide a small prod sample (1–2 representative queries + latency histogram) and answers to the questionnaire — target 1/28.
3) Ops alignment: schedule a 60-minute pilot scoping with engineering and infra (propose 2/1 or 2/2).

Pilot proposal (high level)
- 2-week pilot: focused on 1000 gateways (representative), metric collection via OTLP, latency SLO target configuration, and cost estimate for production rollout.
- Success criteria: sustained p95 <200ms for the representative workload, OTLP metrics ingested, and a documented plan for private deployment onto your VPC.

Attachments included: edgeml-demo-deck.pdf, novaforge-security-questions.docx

If the timeline above looks off, let me know — we can push the pilot window. Happy to set up the pilot scoping meeting once you have comments on the questionnaire.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Clara,

Wanted to bump this thread — I haven't seen the completed questionnaire or sample queries yet and wanted to check whether the timeline and priority we discussed are still accurate. I know budgets and priorities can shift quickly after conferences. A couple quick options if you're still interested:

- Fast path: we can run an initial pilot with a small sample (no NDA required) in ~2 weeks; we'll provide a $5k pilot credit to cover runtime and initial engineering time.
- Security-first path: if you need extra compliance review, we can loop in our security lead and propose a dedicated review slot next week.

If your priorities changed, totally understand — would you mind a one-line update so we can either pause or keep the pilot slot open?

If helpful, next available times for a 30-minute sync are Mon 1/25 10am PT or Tue 1/26 2pm PT.

Thanks,
